messages:
ella: hey! second day 00 — quick practicals: where do i drop a quick how-to vs an actual bug vs just an intro? and my phone is getting a million CI pings :sweat_smile:
marta (People Ops): welcome! super short:
- intros -> #new-hires or #random if it's casual
- how-tos / usage Qs -> #help or the feature channel (e.g., #api, #embeddings)
- reproducible bugs -> root post in #help or the service channel, include a minimal repro and env
- private HR things -> DM People Ops
jo (Eng): for bugs please paste a tiny repro in the root and then thread follow-ups. Example we prefer: ```Service: tokenizer
Env: macOS 13
Cmd: ./run_local_test.sh
Observed: segfault on init
Expected: process starts``` That saves everyone a roundtrip. If it's customer-impacting ping @eng-oncall.
devex (DevEx): CI and deploy bot control: try `/ci digest on` to get a single daily summary instead of per-build DMs. You can also mute channels you don't want to see and rely on mentions for critical alerts. For onboarding reminders use `/onboard subscribe daily` or `/onboard pace slow`.
ella: lovely. small etiquette Q: i see people reply in-thread almost always 44d is that the rule?
marta (People Ops): yes — keep the conversation in-thread for that topic. start a new thread for a new subject. Threads keep the channel readable and searchable.
jo (Eng): reactions are the fast way to ack (:eyes: for "i'm looking", :white_check_mark: for "done/resolved"). If it's an approval or decision, add an explicit comment so it shows up in search.
ella: how do i silence a bot temporarily? my phone buzzes at 3am for CI sometimes
devex (DevEx): use `/ci mute me` to stop build DMs and `/deploy snooze 8h` for deploy-bot. Also App Settings > Notifications -> "Only @mentions" is a good global setting.
onboard-bot: Onboard Tip Day 2: Join your team standup + set up SSH keys. Reply `skip` to silence today.
ci-bot: [ci] build #4001 failed (linux/integration) - see https://ci.redwood.com/build/4001
ella: perfect, thanks folks 64f i'll post reproducible snippets in #help, keep follow-ups in-thread, and turn CI to digest. also will DM for payroll. :smile:
